# Drive Medical 1239RD Foldable Rollator Walker with Seat, Red
Brand: Drive Medical
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
Walker with Seat: Stylish and modern 2-wheel walker with seat comes with a lightweight frame, a comfortable and convenient padded seat and backrest, and height-adjustable contoured handles for a comfortable grip; Safe and Secure: Wheeled walker features rear leg tips that act as brakes when pressed down for extra safety and protection; equipped with large swivel wheels in front for optimal steering and maneuverability; Foldable Rollator Walker: Lightweight portable rollator easily folds when not in use to be transported with ease; Limited Lifetime Warranty: Your Drive 2 wheel walker is backed by a limited lifetime warranty so you can buy with confidence

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 56.99 USD.
Rated 4.4 from 1917 reviews.
Top review: This walker is what was recommended for stability. My mom could not use four wheeled walkers with handbrakes because her hands aren’t strong enough, and her reflexes are slow. We were worried that a 4-wheeled walker would roll away and cause her to fall. This one works well because it has 2 wheels and does not need handbrakes. It rolls easily, but can’t get away from her and has a seat for when she gets tired. It folds easily enough, though not super easy. I do recommend for those that fall often. Great value for the price too.I am thankful to have found this at an affordable price. It works great for my Mom who is in assisted living. We took her to Lowe's and she used it and was able to sit down on it. Very practical and so useful!Never used a walker before. This was easy for me to handle. It was great for my situation. For now it's my best friend as my foot heals.very niceBought this for my mom for her original walker was from the hospital and does not have a chair. She gets tired and complains of pain by walking just several feet and always looking to sit down. Hence, this was perfect. She loves it, but she finds it hard to maneuver when there's carpet to regular flooring and on gravel or uneven ground. When she wants to sit, we have to position the wheels by a curve or wall for it does not have a break or lock so for safety reason, we do it that way. We have not found it rolling.I would've loved to have given 5 stars - But it was missing 2 screws and washers. My husband had replacement parts - Thank goodness or we would've returned it. It works GREAT, now we can take my Aunt out for longer walking / shopping trips and she can get the rest she needs in between.I bought this for my mom when she started having trouble walking and it works great for her. It is light weight and was very easy to assemble as the bulk of it was already put together. I am very pleased with this product.Very nice! Great to set up and moves in every direction nicely. Stays put when you need it. Love the price!We are stuck with an unsafe walker with missing part.Drive medical has made it
